name: Goodday MCP
description: GoodDay is the modern ERP built for Shopify brands scaling to omnichannel. This connector lets your team manage inventory operations in plain language: check inventory across locations, review purchase and sales orders, move stock with transfers, post adjustments, and pull live inventory data. Every write goes through built-in safety guards, so your team moves faster without putting orders or stock at risk. Built and maintained by GoodDay Software in Austin, Texas

_published_faq.name: How do I add Goodday MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Goodday MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gooddayai.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Goodday MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Goodday MCP lists 47 MCP tools, including adjust_inventory, check_inventory, check_inventory_history, check_inventory_live, check_purchase_order_live, check_purchase_orders, check_sales_order_live, check_sales_orders, check_transfer_live, check_transfers, complete_transfer_receipt, and count_inventory.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Goodday MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Goodday MCP in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Goodday MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Goodday MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Goodday MCP is developed by GoodDay Software. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
